# Compliant adopter fixture

A miniature project that satisfies every rule a detector can evaluate. It exists to be audited by the
test suite and must provoke no findings.

Its artifacts are copied from `docs/examples/`, so the examples are executable evidence rather than
decoration: an example that stopped satisfying the standards fails the build.

## Scope

This is a fixture. It provides general wellness information for testing purposes only. It does not
diagnose conditions, does not provide medical assessment, and is not a substitute for evaluation by a
qualified clinician. Nothing in it describes a real person.

This paragraph is also what `escalation.scope-disclosed` looks for.

## Trend over event

Individual observations inform decisions; trends establish patterns. A single reading, workout, meal,
or weigh-in does not redefine the plan.

This sentence is what `trend.principle-documented` looks for.
